headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 7, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. In other action, the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, securing a decisive win, while the Cincinnati Reds edged the Athletics 6-5 in a thrilling finish.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Luinder Avila of the Kansas City Royals being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right forearm tightness. Other injured players include Blake Dunn of the Cincinnati Reds, Ryan Thompson of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Hunter Greene of the Cincinnati Reds, Sam Bachman of the Los Angeles Angels, Patrick Corbin of the Toronto Blue Jays, Trey Yesavage of the Toronto Blue Jays, and James Wood of the Washington Nationals.

The Kansas City Royals have made several roster moves, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Angels Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics 6-5 in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow 6-5 victory over the Athletics, with Andrew Abbott earning the win. Brian Serven led the Athletics' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, securing a decisive win. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Pirates 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Dustin May earning the win. Gary Sánchez led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Aaron Ashby pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief for the Brewers, striking out 3 batters.

top_news.title: **Royals Roster Update: Luinder Avila Moves to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-handed pitcher Luinder Avila has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right forearm tightness.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have added first baseman Jacob Berry to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being dealt to the team.
